name: collabcode
description: Repository tooling for CollabCode: linting, formatting and end-to-end tests. The app itself lives in client/ and server/.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm --prefix client run check:contrast
